PMO/Finance set the portfolio investment envelope against the capex/OpEx plan (links to VS-40/VS-33.1/VS-17.4) and the resource/capacity constraints (W3553); define portfolio KPIs (on-time, on-budget, benefits realization, stage-gate compliance) and the review cadence

COO/CFO approve the portfolio strategy and PMO charter, ratify governance bodies and authorities, and integrate to the corporate plan (links to VS-33) and board reporting (links to VS-36); communicate to the organization

steps.activity: PMO receive and log the project request/intake: idea, sponsor, problem/opportunity statement, rough scope, estimated cost/benefit, category (capital/IT/transformation/regulatory), and urgency; perform initial triage (in-scope, duplicate, defer, reject)

PMO classify the project: type (capital store/DC/renewable/fleet/IT/transformation/regulatory), size/tier (major/minor/small-works), delivery approach (waterfall/agile/hybrid), and the applicable stage-gate (W3548) and authority (links to VS-36/VS-40); route to the relevant delivery-domain VS (VS-20/VS-37/VS-109/VS-108/VS-27/etc.)

PMO register the project in the portfolio/PMIS (links to W3562), assign a project ID/charter-draft, and queue for prioritization (W3547) and approval (W3551); maintain the portfolio register and pipeline view

fields.Participants: PMO, Strategy (links to VS-33), Finance (links to VS-40/VS-17.4), Sponsors, Resource Owners (links to VS-19), Executive Committee

Automation Opportunity: - System rule-based auto-approval of "approve/defer/reject per ranking, balance across categories and the…" (replaces manual Step 2).

Controls: - CTL-565 (ensure controlled execution — Project Portfolio Governance, Prioritization & Stage-Gate (PA-112.1).)
- operational: transparent scoring; operational: capacity-aware allocation (W3553)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Politics-over-merit risk**: Prioritization driven by influence not merit; mitigated by transparent scoring
- **Over-commitment risk**: Approving more than capacity/resources allow; mitigated by capacity-aware allocation (W3553)
System Touchpoints: - Strategy (links to VS-33); capex/finance (links to VS-40/VS-17.4); resource/capacity (links to VS-19/W3553); PMIS (links to W3562); dashboards (links to W3552)

steps.activity: PMO/Strategy score and prioritize projects against criteria: strategic alignment (links to VS-33), financial return (NPV/IRR/payback links to VS-40), risk, urgency/regulatory (links to VS-22), resource demand (W3553), and dependencies (W3550); produce the ranked portfolio view

PMO/Finance allocate the portfolio to the investment envelope (links to VS-33.1/VS-40/VS-17.4) and resource/capacity (W3553): approve/defer/reject per ranking, balance across categories and the capital/OpEx split, and manage trade-offs; sequence against the multi-year plan

PMO publish the prioritized portfolio and resource allocation, communicate approve/defer/reject decisions to sponsors, and update the portfolio register (W3546) and dashboards (W3552); re-prioritize on change (new request, constraint, strategic shift)

fields.Participants: PMO, Delivery Leads (links to VS-20/VS-37/VS-109/VS-108/VS-27), Quality (links to VS-31), Finance (links to VS-40), Sponsors

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-log of "methodology and project-lifecycle standards" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-review of "review gate readiness" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-track of "track stage-gate compliance across the portfolio, enforce discipline" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-565 (ensure controlled execution — Project Portfolio Governance, Prioritization & Stage-Gate (PA-112.1).)
- operational: enforcement and waivers; operational: tiered/appropriate methodology
Pain Points / Risks: - **Gate-bypass risk**: Projects skip gates, eroding control; mitigated by enforcement and waivers
- **Methodology-mismatch risk**: Heavy waterfall applied to agile IT work; mitigated by tiered/appropriate methodology
System Touchpoints: - PMIS/gate model (links to W3562); templates/standards (links to W3566); governance (links to VS-36); quality (links to VS-31); capex (links to VS-40)

steps.activity: PMO maintain the stage-gate methodology and project-lifecycle standards: stages (initiate → plan → execute → close, with domain-specific gates for capital/IT/transformation), gate criteria/deliverables, go/no-go/kill decisions, and the documentation/templates per stage (charter, plan, business case, risk register, closure); align to PMBOK/PRINCE2/Agile as appropriate

PMO apply the stage-gate to each project: review gate readiness (deliverables, budget/schedule/benefit status, risk), conduct the gate review with the sponsor/governance, and make the go/no-go/kill/hold decision; capture the decision and conditions

PMO track stage-gate compliance across the portfolio, enforce discipline (no gate-skip without waiver), and feed compliance to dashboards (W3552) and maturity/CI (W3565); evolve the methodology from lessons (W3560)

fields.Participants: Program Manager, PMO, Sponsors, Project Managers, Strategy (links to VS-33), Innovation/Digital (links to VS-30), Finance (links to VS-40)

steps.activity: Program Manager/PMO establish the program: program charter, strategic outcomes/benefits, component projects (links to W3546), inter-project dependencies, program governance, and the program roadmap; align to corporate strategy (links to VS-33) and transformation (links to VS-30)

Program Manager manage the program: coordinate component projects (W3554–W3560), manage cross-project dependencies/sequencing (W3550), consolidated program budget/schedule/risk (links to VS-40), stakeholder communications (W3559), and benefit tracking (W3561); resolve escalations

Program Manager/PMO conduct program reviews and stage-gates (W3548), report program status to governance (W3552), and close the program on outcome delivery with benefits realization (W3561) and lessons (W3560)

- System auto-log of "PMO report portfolio risk/dependency/conflict status to governance" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-137 (ensure project portfolio approval & cost control.)

System Touchpoints: - ERM/risk register (links to VS-21.2); PMIS/dependency (links to W3562); resource (links to W3553); governance (links to VS-36); dashboards (links to W3552)

steps.activity: PMO/Risk maintain the portfolio risk and dependency view: aggregate project/program risks (W3558), cross-project dependencies (technical, resource, schedule, scope), resource conflicts (W3553), and strategic/external risks; integrate to ERM (links to VS-21.2)

PMO/Project Managers manage dependencies and conflicts: identify critical-path dependencies, manage resource conflicts (re-prioritize W3547 or resource W3553), resolve scope/schedule conflicts, and escalate to governance; mitigate portfolio-level risks

PMO report portfolio risk/dependency/conflict status to governance (W3552) and risk committee (links to VS-21.2/VS-36), track mitigation effectiveness, and feed learnings to planning (W3547) and methodology (W3548)

steps.activity: Sponsor/PMO develop the project charter and business case: objectives/scope, deliverables, high-level plan and milestones, cost estimate (links to VS-40), benefits/ROI (W3561), risks/assumptions, sponsor/PM/stakeholders, and success criteria; align to strategy (links to VS-33)

steps.activity: PMO/BI produce the portfolio dashboards: status of all projects/programs (stage, schedule, budget, benefits, risk, issues), portfolio KPIs (on-time/on-budget %, stage-gate compliance, benefits realization), resource utilization (W3553), and pipeline; tailored views per audience (PMO/exec/board)

PMO/Strategy report the portfolio to the executive committee (links to VS-33.2): performance vs plan, at-risk projects/programs, decisions needed (re-prioritize, kill, fund), and strategic alignment; drive decisions and actions

PMO/COO report to the Board (links to VS-36): major capital and transformation programs, portfolio health, risk, and benefits; ensure board oversight of significant projects (per authority links to VS-36) and alignment to corporate strategy
